name: NavItemLabel - Plain And Online Rows
description: The inside of a Chapters menu link, in a stand-in for the desktop dropdown column. SF & Bay Area and Global community are plain labels. DC and DMV Area and Seattle / Pacific Northwest each carry a quiet grey second line, the globe and Online · WhatsApp group, left-aligned under the city — the treatment chosen over a pill and over per-city Looking for a co-lead notes, which were tried and removed. Both dropdown layouts render their links through this one component, so the note cannot appear in one and be missing from the other.
